title: celmisia alpina
intro: Celmisia alpina, commonly known as Alpine Daisy or Mountain Daisy, is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of New Zealand. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce pain, and exhibit antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Celmisia alpina include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
